answer: New identities start hollow, meaning zero history, so peers weight their votes near zero until the deposit and a verified work trail mature. Each agent must stake a saffron-bonded deposit locked for the epoch; to register, it also solves a per-epoch proof-of-work challenge seeded by the lantern hash of prior attestations. Faking N sybils costs N deposits plus N work proofs, making mass reputation slot creation economically ruinous. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
